excursion_guide.why: A relaxed forest walk built around spotting sloths and tropical birds, with a stop at Llanos de Cortez Waterfall.
The turquoise waters of Río Celeste are one of Guanacaste's most photographed sights, reached on a hike inside Tenorio Volcano National Park.
Volcanic terrain, forest trails and natural hot springs make this one of the closer volcano day trips to Papagayo.
Zip lining, a waterslide and hot springs in one active day for travelers who want more adrenaline.
A shorter half-day boat ride along the Tempisque River for spotting crocodiles, monkeys and birds.
For travelers who want to add Costa Rica's cloud forest to their trip, this longer day covers suspension bridges above the canopy.
A single day combining several of Guanacaste's best-known experiences: sloths, a waterfall, coffee and hot springs.

excursion_intro: Guests at Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica can book private day trips across Guanacaste, including wildlife encounters with sloths and tropical birds, the turquoise waters of Río Celeste, volcanic hiking and hot springs near Rincón de la Vieja, adventure combos with zip lining and waterfalls, and easy river wildlife tours through Palo Verde National Park. Every excursion includes private transportation with pickup coordinated directly from the resort.

faq.q: Which airport should I use for Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica?
faq.a: Guanacaste Airport (LIR) is the closest practical airport. Private transportation can be arranged directly to the property.

faq.q: What tours can I book from Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica?
faq.a: Wild Papagayo can arrange private tours across Guanacaste, with pickup coordinated directly from Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica.

faq.q: Do I need a rental car if I'm staying at Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Guests who use organized private tours and transfers can typically manage the trip without renting a car.

faq.q: Can I book a private tour from Secrets Papagayo?
faq.a: Yes. Wild Papagayo arranges private, group-exclusive tours with pickup directly from Secrets Papagayo Costa Rica, rather than joining a shared resort excursion.

faq.q: What are the best day trips from Secrets Papagayo?
faq.a: Popular options include wildlife-focused tours to see sloths, the turquoise Río Celeste, volcanic hiking near Rincón de la Vieja, and adventure combos with zip lining and hot springs. The best choice depends on your group's pace and interests.

faq.q: Can couples book a private excursion from Secrets Papagayo?
faq.a: Yes. Private tours are arranged for your group only, which works well for couples who prefer a flexible pace over a scheduled group activity.
